mainFocus: Windows infrastructure foundations and Git discipline.
outcome: You can build a working Windows domain, join clients, apply basic policies, document the lab, and save progress in Git.
weeklyHabits: Make at least three Git commits per week
Document every lab change in Markdown
Capture one screenshot or command output for each completed lab task
Review one Windows Server, DNS, DHCP, AD, or GPO concept each week
recommendedCourses: MDN HTML and CSS basics for the roadmap site
projectDeliverables: DNS forward and reverse lookup notes
confidenceCheckpoint: You can explain how a Windows client receives an IP address, resolves the domain controller, joins the domain, and receives Group Policy.

mainFocus: PowerShell automation, Entra ID concepts, Intune basics, and operational reporting.
outcome: You can automate common account and reporting workflows instead of completing every task manually.
weeklyHabits: Write or improve one PowerShell script each week
Use Git branches for script changes
Test scripts against lab users before documenting them
Write down every error and how you fixed it
recommendedCourses: Learn PowerShell in a Month of Lunches
confidenceCheckpoint: You can explain a joiner, mover, and leaver process and show which parts your PowerShell scripts automate.

mainFocus: Linux administration, Python automation, and Docker-based services.
outcome: You can administer Linux services, process infrastructure data with Python, and run repeatable local services with Docker Compose.
weeklyHabits: Use Linux terminal commands daily
Read service logs with journalctl
Write one small Python automation task per week
Containerize one service or tool
confidenceCheckpoint: You can recover a broken Linux service, inspect logs, explain the fix, and commit the documented result.

mainFocus: CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and configuration management.
outcome: You can define infrastructure and configuration in code, run automated checks, and deploy changes repeatably.
weeklyHabits: Review every infrastructure change with git diff before committing
Run builds or checks before push
Keep secrets out of Git
Document rollback steps for every automation workflow
confidenceCheckpoint: You can explain how a Git push can trigger validation, build output, infrastructure planning, and deployment.

mainFocus: Kubernetes, monitoring, reliability, and integrated platform operations.
outcome: You can explain and demonstrate a complete infrastructure workflow from request to deployed and monitored service.
weeklyHabits: Deploy or modify one service in the cluster each week
Write a runbook for every repeated operational task
Test one failure scenario each month
Review monitoring dashboards and alert quality
confidenceCheckpoint: You can walk through the full lab and explain how identity, automation, infrastructure, deployment, and monitoring connect.
